name: An end-of-life decline with an ambulance already called
description: Raj has a severe UTI; the GP sends him in and an ambulance is called at 12:51. His planned end-of-life decline (2 days) begins at 13:10, while the ambulance is on its way. He is taken to hospital anyway at 14:10 (against a planned death at home); his expected death passes while he's away, and he dies within minutes of coming back.
